description: The chart illustrates different distributions of bar heights across five categories, labeled Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck, with an unlabeled category on the left. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with no explicit label, and are ordered from left to right. The vertical axis is unlabeled and lacks tick labels or a scale, but it appears to represent the magnitude or value of the bars. Each category contains a set of four bars, colored in various shades of green, with the height of the bars varying across categories. The Uniform category has bars of equal height, while the other categories display distinct patterns: Decreasing has bars that generally decrease in height from left to right, Spindle has taller bars in the middle and shorter bars on the ends, and Bottleneck has shorter bars in the middle and taller bars on the ends. The unlabeled category on the left has bars that increase in height from left to right. The bars within each category are not labeled or distinguished by different colors, but their relative heights are clearly visible. The chart does not display any explicit sorting or visual emphasis on specific bars.
